# T4.7 (TASKS.md) -- heir-first dispatch (DESIGN.md §2.7). When
# HeirLogPriority is set, bcastAppend sends to the heir first -- dispatch
# ordering only, no change to commit rule, quorum semantics, or
# acknowledgement handling. Written first per the TDD convention, before
# bcastAppend's reordering landed in raft.go.

log-level error
----
ok

# Cluster A: heir-log-priority=true. id 4 is the highest scorer and becomes
# heir. The very first append round (during the election itself) still uses
# natural (sorted-id) order, since no heir is known yet at that point --
# reordering only kicks in from the first proposal made *after* selection.
add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3,4) index=2 heir-election=true heir-log-priority=true stability-score=50
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3,4) index=2 heir-election=true heir-log-priority=true stability-score=90
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3,4) index=2 heir-election=true heir-log-priority=true stability-score=100
----
ok

----
ok
